board-records:independent-reevaluation.audited_by: auditor subagent; code in results/indep/ shares nothing with verifier/, qlib/ or work/lead/
board-records:independent-reevaluation.method: operators stored as weighted Schur blocks; each Pauli channel written as exp(G) with G a Lindblad generator whose action on the blocks is built from spin-1/2 Clebsch-Gordan coefficients (PIQS-style Dicke master equation), exp applied by a positive Poisson series (two_pauli: the one negative-rate piece commutes and is applied first by Taylor series); X-Z and 2-Pauli also run in the exp(-i pi/4 X) frame; entropies by LAPACK; O(n^4). No coherent-state kernel, Horner binomials or Dicke partial traces. Shared ingredients: the Schur-Weyl block decomposition and I_c as a sum over blocks.
board-records:independent-reevaluation.validation: brute force 2^n, n<=10, ranks 1-4, all families, both frames: max diff 1.7e-14; Pauli-weight operator spectrum test to n=30; KG2026 state A at 16239/250000 and our n=45 state at 6497/100000 agree with KG exact certificates to 1.3e-15; 45-digit re-run at n=48 (X-Z, 2-Pauli): float error 3e-15 / 6e-15; at n=150/240 two exp algorithms agree to 9e-16, two eigensolvers to 1e-15, random block rotations move I_c by <= 6e-14
board-records:independent-reevaluation.error: measured float64 error ~1e-13 bits or better; conservative LAPACK worst-case bound <= 7.5e-10 (n=240), not rigorous (the board verifier is the rigorous enclosure)
findings: large-n states are flat in p: |dI_c/dp| = 3.5e-5 (dep n=150), 5.7e-5 (dep n=240), 8-9e-4 (X-Z, 2-Pauli n=64) bits per unit p, against 0.017-0.023 at n=45-48. So the fixed float margins (2e-9..1e-8 bits) used to pick p left 1e-5..7e-5 in p unclaimed; work/lead/maxcert.py now bisects p against the verifier
verifier enclosures for these states are 2.8e-10..1.45e-9 bits wide, 10-50x the widths PROBLEM.md quoted for the test states (many tiny eigenvalues from the Gaussian envelope)

independent_xz and two_pauli antidegradability: antidegradability (Q = 0) sets in at p = (1-1/sqrt2)/2 = 0.146447 (X-Z) and 1/6 (2-Pauli), tighter than records.json zero_capacity_from 293/1000 and 1/4. The auditor proposed the closed form sqrt(pI) <= sqrt(pX)+sqrt(pY)+sqrt(pZ); results/zero_capacity_sdp.py confirms it with a symmetric-extension SDP on the Choi state (CLARABEL): 0.083333 / 0.146446 / 0.166545 for depolarizing / X-Z / 2-Pauli (the 2-Pauli SDP value sits 1.2e-4 low because its Choi state is rank 3 and the test uses a 1e-7 eigenvalue tolerance). All certified values lie below. Tightening the verifier alarm needs a re-freeze (records.json is pinned).

rigorous-arb:independent-certification.audited_by: auditor subagent (built results/rigorous/, 2026-10-27/28); spot re-run of the X-Z record by lead reproduced the enclosure exactly
rigorous-arb:independent-certification.method: results/rigorous/arb_ic.py: 128-bit Arb (python-flint 0.9.0) ball arithmetic throughout. Exact inputs (doubles, rational p, rational Z). Channel = exp(G) with the Lindblad/Clebsch-Gordan construction of results/indep (not the board's det^k Sym^{2j} kernel), positive-rate part by Poisson uniformisation with a rigorous tail bound (<= 2.8e-44 in trace norm, added as a Weyl perturbation), the 2-Pauli negative rate by a Taylor series with a rigorous tail. X-Z / 2-Pauli in the exp(-i pi/4 X) frame via an exact Krawtchouk closed form. Spectra: float hints refined in Arb (untrusted), then certified by Gershgorin components on X*HX with Ostrowski's theorem for the non-orthogonality of X; -x log2 x bounded on each interval with Arb logs. Shares no code with verifier/ and does not use its formula.
rigorous-arb:independent-certification.validation: 252 brute-force cases n<=8 (all families, ranks 1-3) contain results/indep/brute.py values to float error; 35 cases inside a 50-digit mpmath reference (hpbrute.py); spectral unit test with exact degeneracies, 1e-30/1e-40 clusters and 1e-76 tails (test_eig.py, all OK); Krohn-Grimberghe: state A at 16239/250000 = 8.608876805954981e-8 (their certificate [8.3895e-8, 8.7075e-8]), our n=45 state at 6497/100000 inside KG's exact interval and 1e4 times narrower, all four KG signs reproduced; negative controls (p just above each float zero crossing, one amplitude perturbed by 1e-4) come out NEGATIVE.

conservative_points.note: highest p whose BOARD-verifier lower bound is >= 1e-9 bits (work/lead/maxcert.py --min-lower 1e-9), then re-certified with arb_ic; files in work/lead/cands/

rigorous-arb:independent-certification.finding: the board verifier's enclosures (2e-9..7.6e-9 bits wide) are dominated by the double-precision floor on many tiny eigenvalues; the 128-bit Arb evaluator is 1e20 times narrower, so it certifies up to ~1e-6 below a state's float zero crossing. It is also O(n^4) for every Pauli channel (board path 1 is O(n^6)); at n=120 board path 1 took 43 min with a 5.3e-8-bit enclosure (UNDECIDED at p=0.1259 for an X-Z state that arb certifies far higher), so beyond n=80 only the Arb evaluator can certify X-Z / 2-Pauli usefully.
